dataset.attribution: APIVault-curated API metadata based on provider-controlled official documentation. API usage rights, model licenses, service terms, and pricing remain governed by each provider.

apis.name: Cohere
apis.summary: Access Cohere-hosted language models for chat, embeddings, reranking, and related natural-language processing tasks.
apis.description: Cohere provides hosted APIs for its Command, Embed, Rerank, and related models. The v2 API and SDK documentation describe API-key authentication; evaluation keys are free with usage limits, while production keys are paid and have different limits. Model-specific capabilities and pricing should be checked in the linked provider documentation.
apis.pricingSummary: Evaluation keys are free with usage limits; production keys are paid. Model pricing and production limits vary and should be checked against current Cohere pricing documentation.

authMethods.details: The Cohere client accepts an API key; official docs distinguish evaluation/trial keys from production keys.

apis.name: DeepAI
apis.summary: Use DeepAI REST APIs for image generation, image editing, upscaling, background removal, and related AI tools.
apis.description: DeepAI exposes REST endpoints for image generation, editing, super-resolution, background removal, and video generation. API requests use an API key in the api-key header. The provider states that API access is included with DeepAI Pro and usage beyond included allowances can draw from a prepaid wallet.
apis.pricingSummary: API access is included with DeepAI Pro; usage beyond plan allowances is charged against a prepaid wallet. Confirm current subscription and overage rates on the provider pricing page.

authMethods.details: Requests pass the account API key in the api-key HTTP header; the provider states API access requires an active DeepAI Pro subscription.

sources.title: DeepAI API documentation
sources.notes: Official API reference documenting REST endpoints, API-key header authentication, and request formats.

sources.title: DeepAI for Developers
sources.notes: Provider developer page shows the api-key header and explains API access requirements.

sources.title: DeepAI Pro pricing
sources.notes: Provider pricing page documents the subscription, monthly allowances, and prepaid-wallet overages.

apis.name: Replicate
apis.summary: Run hosted machine-learning models through a REST API for predictions, deployments, model management, and training.
apis.description: Replicate provides an HTTP API for running public and private machine-learning models, creating predictions, managing deployments, and training models. Requests use a Replicate API token in the Authorization header with the Bearer scheme. Pricing varies by model and compute hardware.
apis.pricingSummary: Usage is billed according to model and compute hardware; private deployments can also incur charges while instances are idle. Consult current provider pricing before estimating costs.

authMethods.details: All HTTP API requests require a Replicate API token in the Authorization header using the Bearer scheme.
